title: 偏好嵌入而非语义嵌入
summary: 本文提出偏好嵌入概念，用于集体决策中自由文本意见的向量表示。标准语义嵌入无法准确反映偏好相似性，存在不变性问题。通过合成训练数据打破语义与偏好相关性，显著提升偏好预测效果。
summary_en: This paper proposes preference embeddings for representing free-text opinions in collective decision-making. Standard semantic embeddings fail to capture preferential similarity due to an invariance problem. Synthetic training data that breaks the correlation between semantics and preferences significantly improves preference prediction.
